currentTask.status: The roadmap has been reordered at Pooya's request: Phase 7 readiness first; Phase 8 is the penultimate full-site redesign and two-round owner approval; Phase 9 is the final pre-release integration of all eight independent projects; Phase 10 is V1 release. Latest upstream source commits for all eight projects were inspected read-only and recorded. Continue Phase 7 technical closeout; do not begin final visual redesign or project integration early.
